description: Show an agent wallet as it actually stands on-chain: vault balance, how much of the delegated allowance is left, what it can spend right now, its fee SOL, the guardrails in force, spend totals for the last 24 hours, and any warnings (revoked, expired, paused, out of fee SOL, allowance unbacked by balance). Read-only.
name: agent_wallet_status
title: Live status of an agent wallet
